faq.a1: Yes — start planning for free with all the core features: trips, bookings, budget, documents and the timeline. Advanced collaboration and AI features are part of the Pro plan.
faq.a2: Forward a confirmation email, paste text or upload a PDF or screenshot. The AI extracts dates, locations, confirmation codes and prices, then files a structured booking into the right trip — and updates your budget and readiness status automatically.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Invite any number of companions into a trip. Everyone works in the same space, uploads bookings, sees changes live — and the group chat includes the AI assistant.
faq.a4: No. A public share link opens a read-only view of your trip in any browser — no registration, no app install.
faq.a5: It sends reminders about trip events, answers questions about your itinerary, shares booking details, locations and files, and gives general travel advice — all inside Telegram, no app needed mid-journey.
faq.a6: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Documents are visible only to you and the companions you invite. Public links show the plan — never your personal documents.
faq.lede: Short answers to the things people always want to know first. Anything else - write to us inside the app.

demo.meta.title: Demo trip · Triplanio
demo.meta.desc: A live example of a Triplanio trip: the route on a map, a day-by-day timeline, budget, documents, and a Telegram assistant.
demo.hero.title: The Mediterranean Loop
demo.hero.sub: Three countries in nineteen days: Italy, Spain, Portugal. Trains where they beat flying, and a car for two days in the Douro Valley. Departing and returning from Berlin.
demo.hero.people: Ava, Marco, Priya and Noah are planning together · one invitation on the road
demo.route.p: Cities connect in the order they sit in the itinerary. A flight is drawn as an arc, a ground transfer follows real roads, and a leg with no transfer yet stays dashed. Valencia → Madrid is dashed on this map for exactly that reason.
demo.tl.p: Cities, stays, activities and transfers live in one feed — by day and by hour. Alongside them are service events found on no ticket: free-cancellation deadlines and the gaps Triplanio spots on its own.
demo.tl.d1.e1.s: Barcelona, 17–20 May · cancellation becomes paid after this
demo.tl.d1.e1.pill: we'll remind you a day ahead
demo.tl.d1.e2.t: Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel
demo.tl.d1.e3.s: Food · Via dei Giubbonari 21 · added by Marco
demo.tl.d3.e1.t: Sagrada Família and the Nativity tower
demo.tl.d4.e2.s: The cities sit next to each other in the route, but how to get between them isn't set
demo.tl.d4.e3.s: Three nights are in the route, the booking isn't
demo.bud.p: A booking has a price — so it's already an expense, tagged «booking» and in its category. Coffee, taxis and market ceramics are added by hand. The categories «Stay», «Transport», «Activities» and «Services» come with the trip; you can invent the rest.
demo.bud.perone: Per person, split evenly among four
demo.bud.fx: Spending in other currencies is converted at the exchange rate — you can set the rate by hand too
demo.more.p: The same events look back at you from four different places — and stay the same events everywhere.
demo.more.cal.p: The bar under a date is the city you sleep in; on a travel day it's two colours. The dots above it are that day's events.
demo.more.cal.wd: Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su
demo.more.docs.p: Shared ones are visible to the whole group; personal ones only to whoever uploaded them.
demo.more.svc.p: Three things people usually remember at the airport.
demo.more.stat.p: Calculated from the route, not from a separate form.
demo.team.h2b: and nobody gets in the way
demo.team.p: The owner created the trip, admins edit the route and budget, the viewer sees everything but breaks nothing. And the group chat has a fifth voice: mention @Triplanio and an assistant that knows this route replies.

demo.tg.h2a: On the trip you don't need
demo.tg.p: Each member links their own Telegram in the trip settings. From there the bot writes on its own — about events already in the route. You can also ask it a question or send it a document.
demo.tg.p1.p: Check-in, check-out, train, activity, free-cancellation deadline. Not «good morning», but what costs money.
demo.tg.p2.p: «What time is the train?», «What's the hotel address?» — the assistant looks into this route, not at the world in general.
demo.tg.p3.p: Ask for a voucher, ticket or insurance — the assistant finds the file in the trip documents and sends it right into the chat.
demo.fin.sub: Add cities and dates — the route, map, calendar and timeline build themselves. After that you just add bookings, and the prices flow into the budget on their own.
